sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Mag Drills is a Practical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Skill aimed at magazine handling - loading and unloading of ammo, checking for remaining cartridges.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
After reaching level 10 in this skill, the check accuracy level for all magazines increases from 0 to 1. This means that instead of just showing "Full", "Nearly full", "About half", "Fewer than half", "Almost empty" and "Empty", the character gives a more accurate estimation, for example "Approx. 15". Check accuracy level 1 is also available on most translucent magazines and ones with an observation slot, like the PM 9x18PM 90-93 8-round magazine, no matter the skill progress.

After reaching level 20 in this skill, the check accuracy level for all magazines increases from 1 to 2. This means that the character gives the exact amount of remaining rounds.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases ammo loading speed (0.6% per level → +30% at Elite Level)
- Increases ammo unloading speed (0.6% per level → -30% at Elite Level)
- Increases magazine check speed through the context menu (0.8% per level → -40% at Elite Level)
- Increases magazine check accuracy through the context menu
- Elite level: Magazine is checked instantly when moved to your inventory
- Elite level: Magazine loading is performed faster with every loaded round

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Performing magazine checks in raid
- Loading and unloading magazines in raid
  - Including internal magazines like shotgun tubes
- Completing the quest A Life Lesson
- Completing the quest Never Too Late To Learn
- Completing the quest Best Job in the World
- Completing the quest Escort
- Completing the quest Intimidator
